idea.title: Temporary Cloudflare Accounts for AI Agents

plan.tagline: Creates temporary Cloudflare accounts for AI agents
plan.problem: Managing multiple Cloudflare accounts for AI agents is cumbersome and prone to errors
plan.solution: CloudAgent creates temporary Cloudflare accounts, assigns them to AI agents, generates reports, and sends notifications, all from a simple CLI interface
plan.target_market: Indie hackers, developers, and small businesses worldwide who use Cloudflare and AI agents
mvp_features: Offline demo mode with hardcoded data

build_phases.name: Core DB + add
build_phases.description: Design sqlite schema and implement add/list commands

build_phases.name: Reports + alerts
build_phases.description: Implement report generation and notification system

plan.demo_script: Creates a temporary Cloudflare account, assigns it to an AI agent, generates a report, and sends a notification, all offline with hardcoded data
